viva.summary: The student shows a basic grasp of the encoding goal and can propose a reasonable modification for error handling, but their explanation of the continuation bit is inaccurate and they failed to predict the correct output for zero.

rubric.revise_next: Review how the continuation bit works in variable‑byte encoding and test the function with edge cases like 0 and small numbers.

questions.answer: Yeh line last byte mein 128 add karti hai taake woh zero ho jaye aur computer ko pata chale number khatam ho gaya. Yeh byte ko reset karne ke liye zaroori hai.
questions.feedback: You identified that the line marks the end of the number, but the purpose is to set the continuation bit (add 128) to indicate the last byte.
questions.prompt: In your `vb_encode` function, what does the line ``bytes[-1] = bytes[-1] + 128`` accomplish and why is it necessary?

messages.body: I got an error when I ran it. Which line should I look at first?
The error means Python couldn't find the name you tried to return, so look at the last line of the function. Did you maybe misspell the list variable?
messages.hint: Check the variable you return; a typo can cause NameError even if the logic is correct.
